I heard at inquest that the urgent referral from Kindandental to the Homerton was made not by logging on to a portal, or by email, or by fax, but by post. This seems unduly slow, cumbersome and prone to mishap.

Following Ms Williams' attendance at the dental surgery on 4 May, an appointment with the maxillofacial unit was made for 30 May, then cancelled by the Homerton on 23 May and re-fixed for 19 June. This date is nearly seven weeks post referral.
